title: Grow through Life: Sources of Help
text: Identify who to contact for help and support, understand sources of guidance, and respond positively to feedback.
cdi_links: 3.G.01 Being aware of sources of help and support and responding positively to feedback

title: Introduction
text: In this lesson, you will explore
bullets: Different sources of help and support
How to respond positively to feedback
Identifying problems at work or school

title: Success Criteria
bullets: I can name sources of help and support
I can respond positively to feedback
I can identify a problem at work or school
I can describe a problem clearly

title: Key Words
bullets: Support Network – A group of people or resources that provide help and guidance
Self-Reflection – Thinking about your own actions and how to improve them

title: Sources of Help
bullets: Teachers, tutors, mentors – Provide personal advice and guidance on learning
Careers advisors, learning support – Help with courses, jobs, and extra support
Family and friends – Encourage you and give honest feedback
Online resources or helplines – Offer information and support anytime

title: Responding Positively to Feedback
bullets: Say thank you to show respect
Reflect on how to act on feedback effectively

title: Activity
text: Think about real people or places you can ask for help, and reflect on problems you have faced or might face at school, work, or home. Make a list of who you could contact, what help you might receive, and how you could respond positively to feedback.

title: Key Takeaways
text: Knowing where to find help is essential
Responding positively to feedback demonstrates maturity
Reflecting on challenges helps personal growth
Support networks help you succeed in school, work, and life
